description: Makes podcast-style and two-character dialogue videos on varg with AI characters who stay the same in every angle: an empty studio set, one wide master shot built from character references, close-ups and lighting cutaways derived from that master, then 5-second image-to-video scenes in which each character speaks their line with native audio, reviewed on an HTML storyboard and stitched into one MP4. Use when someone asks for a podcast video, an AI podcast, a video podcast with two hosts, an interview, debate or talk-show clip between two characters, a myth-vs-truth or "lie vs truth" explainer, or a short of talking characters trading punchy lines. Not for cutting an existing podcast recording into shorts (find a clipping skill with video-skills), one speaker on a stage (use varg-character-keynote), multi-location ads with real actors (use varg-consistent-characters), or songs (use varg-music-video).
